steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: ...'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.'

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: These excellent saplings... must take root and grow in this poisonous land.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Perhaps we made the wrong decision after all, Nearl...

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Grandmaster...

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: The General Chamber was unable to figure out our objective.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Naturally... They must've assumed that we came here to topple them, opportunistically, to consolidate the power of the Adeptus.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: And of course, they'd be correct. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has taken over the supervision of Area 0, and the General Chamber must be made to pay.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: But the businessmen will never understand... just how far we're willing to go for the sake of that girl, Margaret.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.' That has long been the motto of the Nearl family.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: But these words have also been inscribed on the swords, spears, and shields of the nearly thirty members of the Silverlance Pegasus Knightclub.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: During that war, in the midst of that hopeless battle, mired in that pitch-black swamp, Kirill Nearl vowed to save every last besieged knight.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: They were without supplies, their communications cut off. The combined army's artillery division and tactical unit were searching for them.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Nearl only convinced seven knights to take part in the rescue operation. Before they set off, each of them engraved those words on their shields: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.'

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Seven knights set out, but forty-one returned.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: But, of the original seven knights, only Kirill and I remained.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: But the two of you saved over thirty comrades.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: And also... brought back everyone's shields.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.' After that night, all forty-one inscribed those words. On their swords, their armor, their staves, their shields.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: After that, we broke through on the east.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: And when you regrouped with the knightclub again, only seven knights were left once more.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Just as heaven willed.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: But three thousand enemies were wiped out, and the shields of those forty-six knights, all bearing the coats of arms of their respective families, were returned to Kazimierz. Not a single one was left behind.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Daybreak over the Golden Prairie. Every single campaign knight knows this battle well, Grandmaster.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: We salute you!

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: The Armorless Union wants to harm the children of the Nearl family?

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Hah. I wonder if they have enough forces in their reserves.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––What an explosion! The Arts wrapped around our two competitors came into contact, causing a huge blast!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The first to appear from the smoke–– is the Blood Knight! The Blood Knight's been repelled! He's holding his axe in his other hand now–– not his dominant hand! Did his arm go numb from the impact?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: On the other side–– Margaret's supporting herself using her strange swordspear! Without a doubt, the Blood Knight came out on top in this last exchange––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Kuh...!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––The Blood Knight is charging again! Does the Radiant Knight have time to react?!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: What...?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Too bad, but I'm one step ahead of you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Your movements... There's no way skills like that could've been tempered in this playground.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Who did you fight for during your time in exile? When facing an attack, your first instinct is not to evade and counterattack, but to withstand the blow.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: A knight's duty is to defend, even if it means giving her life.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Is it now?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You are not the type to speak lightly of life and death. Show me then, just what life and death mean to you!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What a dazzling display of close-quarters combat––! After the Radiant Knight repelled the onslaught, the two seem to locked in a never-ending melee–– Wait, it's not that simple!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––A huge pool of blood is appearing beneath the two combatants' feet! It's the Blood Knight's trap!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: (Minoan) Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. Exsanguination, to me.
The pool of blood seems to congeal into sticky silk strands, tangling themselves around Margaret's limbs.
The blood flowing through the pegasus's body resonates with its compatriot, causing a tingling pain.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ––As if I'd let you!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: What?! You severed the resonance with your Arts...?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: –––Hraagh!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What a turn of events!! The Blood Knight was trying to control the Radiant Knight using his Arts, but was unexpectedly rebuked! With a hack and smash of the Radiant Knight's swordspear, her opponent has fallen to the ground!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is the first time in the Major that the Blood Knight has been forced to his knees! I'm sure everyone heard that thunderous impact! Just how much damage did our defending champion take?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You should have been able to easily take a blow like that.
The Blood Knight rises to his feet wordlessly and once again brandishes his massive axe, swinging it straight at his opponent's head.

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: (It's a sweeping strike–– but his swing is too erratic!)
A jolt of pain wracks his entire body, forcing the Blood Knight's axe to shift downward slightly.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Urgh—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What... incredible strength...
To him, this pain is both foreign and familiar.
It is unlike being burnt, cut, or frostburned. It is unlike any pain he has ever felt in the arena.
This pain comes from the depths of his body.
His disease.
A tipping point.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: That last blow of yours... hit me hard.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: How do you like this then?
Blood glistens and condenses into an amorphous ball of light.
Margaret has no time to weigh her options. She has to interrupt his Arts.
A glowing aura emerges from behind her.
This light, given form, is strong enough to melt all suffering.

steps.name: A Spectator A
steps.text: Go get 'er, Blood Knight!

steps.name: A Spectator B
steps.text: Stay away from him! Finish him off with your Arts, Margaret!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Knights really are popular, aren't they?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Everyone is in position.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: My dear Monique, would you imagine how nice it would've been if we never formed the Armorless Union, but instead became knights?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: How are things for Platinum?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I almost feel bad for her.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: ...Hmm.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: The Armorless Union... is just you bunch?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Laugh all you want. Not like I can see your expression under that helmet anyway.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: 'Silverlance Pegasus,' huh. Are a few Armorless not good enough for you to sink your teeth into?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The leaders of the Union, and thirty of our members. And you only sent seven.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Are you saying that we don't stand a chance against just seven of you?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: No...

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Three of us will suffice.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's a spear of light! Wait, no, that's the Blood Knight's axe–– it's covered with an aura of blood! But, the Radiant Knight dodged–– Wait, it's a feint! The Radiant Knight's swordspear–– Whew...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I... I have no words to describe what's going on right now! I've never seen such fierce fighting! I'm afraid even an instant replay wouldn't clear it up for us––

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Jealous, Tytus?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The Blood Knight... is very powerful.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I thought... there weren't any Infected who could have such a commanding presence...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I never thought this city could cultivate an iron will like that.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Nearl always told me Kazimierz had forgotten the meaning of glory.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: This city always gave me that impression. Grandstanding, superficial. Mired in an unfathomable depth of consumerism and commercialism.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the people living in this city, every person still fighting to survive... They are all driven on by the conviction in their hearts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nearl was right. That glory, those virtues... will never be forgotten.
Margaret––!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Isn't that...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret––! You can do it!!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: This is no ordinary match. Don't you think our cheering is a bit too ordinary?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It's the thought that counts. Not like Margaret can hear us with how big the crowd is.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Why don't we keep our eyes peeled for the Armorless Union instead? Even if the old bigwigs of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi let us come, who knows if the Union is still hiding out there?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret––!! Take him down!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret––!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The audience's cheers were always only meant for their own ears.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Even if Margaret can't hear them, as long as she remembers that people are supporting her, she will not fall.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Does that mean she's...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: A Nearl... Margaret's little sister, Maria.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Just as Margaret said, everyone eventually came together, right?

a.text: The aura of light grows stronger while the sheen of blood revels in chaos.
The two continue to clash without a single word.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Is the referee still keeping score? No? O-Okay then...)

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Radiant Knight!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Hraaagh––!!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Splendid! You're the only one who could withstand this attack head-on!

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: Likewise... What kind of power is this...
The Blood Knight stands firm and lifts his axe.
Once the Blood Arts enveloping his weapon fades, the once-adamantine Minoan axe crumbles like dust.
Only half of the Radiant Knight's swordspear remains. Its shattered blade punctured the Blood Knight's helmet, revealing his determination-filled eyes.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret's swordspear broke?! I went through so much effort to reinforce it!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Blood Knight's strength is beyond doubt... but he's also lost his weapon!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Now both of them... are unarmed...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...Marvelous...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: This is the first time... I've ever felt that the knight competitions... could bring real joy.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: I recall my hometown. Those white buildings surrounding that pristine, blue lake.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: At the end of the road was a row of blue fences, with a pot of jasmine flowers placed there.
The rusty smell of blood.
The flowing heat of blood.
The raw determination of blood.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Minos is a beautiful place, Blood Knight.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Many knights fight for wealth. Some, for fame.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: But we, the Infected, only fight for survival.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Every match I win, I live a day longer. Another day to spend in the dumps. It's not easy.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: What about you, Radiant Knight?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You are much stronger than I imagined... What have you been through?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh! Nearl is looking over at us?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It seems so.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You can do this, Nearl!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret! You've got this––!!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret, you'd better not lose! I swear, if you end up losing––!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hahaha, it doesn't matter, as long as they have a good rumble.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You bet. It's been so long since I've seen anyone like that Margaret. It's making my hands itchy, old timer.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: (Smiles silently) ......

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Tragedy.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've seen an entire city crumble beneath a Catastrophe. The Infected, slaughtering innocent civilians, stacking their bodies high and burning them as a warning.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've seen bounty hunters torment the poor and downtrodden for sport, parents selling their young children for uncontaminated food and water.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've seen unimaginable tragedy I could never imagine in Kazimierz. However, I also met a group of people... clawing their way forward through that suffering.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I am not alone, Blood Knight.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: And yet, after seeing all that, you still chose to come back to Kazimierz, to reclaim your narrow-minded ideals?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Then, you are no longer narrow-minded.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: This is my last strike, Radiant Knight.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Come. Let's settle this without any further delay. Thinking about anything else... is a right reserved only for the victor!

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: Blood Knight Dikaiopolis, you truly are a great knight.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: And determining which of is the victor... shall bring glory to all of Kazimierz.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: My name is Margaret Nearl! My family motto is, 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness!'

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: (Minoan) From this day forth, I am no longer alone!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: So, will the Blood Knight win, and make things easy for everyone... or will the Radiant Knight win, and we get our hands dirty?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Never thought I'd get to watch the finals on a big screen from the side of the street. What a metropolitan life, hmm?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: ...Absolutely dazzling.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Margaret shines even brighter than before. Losing her would be a huge blow to the Silverlances.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: But when you look at her like this... she really is a rebel after all.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Teams 3 and 4, wait for instructions by the entrance.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Team 5, enter the arena and mark Rhodes Island. Team 6, mark Maria's group.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: The Nearl family has a tendency to produce the most incredible, and the most stubborn people.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Wouldn't you agree, Młynar?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Always feels to me like... it doesn't matter who wins.

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: (Clicks quietly)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: This is a duel between knights.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Blood Knight and the Radiant Knight... they are shining paragons.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But, that's not where our battles are. The things we want can't be found there either.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They opened the way for us... and we must keep fighting.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The two combatants, now without their weapons, are now condensing their Arts to have one last showdown!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What a lengthy struggle! After the light fades, who will be the first to fall?!
Some of the knights at the venue stop their hoarse shouting and cheering.
They slowly rise to their feet, silently waiting for the conclusion.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: The Blood Knight... is at his limit.

a.text: For a moment, it seems as if the entire Grand Knight Territory went silent.
But, a melodious horn from outside the arena breaks the silence.
It soars through the clouds, up beyond the hole-riddled nightscape.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This is a tribute, Kazimierz.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: A hero has risen.
A thunderous roar.
A symphony of clashing sounds.
Each time weapons collide, sparks burst forth and obscure the fight.
The first to fall will be defeated.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...Nngh!
His step falters.
The hero's body has long dried up from his blood-manipulating Arts.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...Radiant Knight.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: How long will you remain in Kazimierz? Will you continue... to kindle this land's lighthouse?

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: When I returned to my homeland––

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: ––I already steeled myself, to never run.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...Good.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Come. We shouldn't leave any regrets behind.

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm sorry, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: This duel... won't have any meaning.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Salute... Salute the Blood Knight.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Salute! Our hero!

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: ...Knight.... Knight...
The Blood Knight gazes at the sky.
He can no longer move a muscle.
The sky.
Even if the nomadic city has moved past that lightless night, the Blood Knight still remembers.
He remembers there was never a moment... when the night surrendered to the city.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...It's your win, Radiant Knight.
Fresh blood spills onto the ground.
Though unable to maintain the basic structure of his Arts, the Blood Knight still clutches the weapon that looks like it could dissipate at any moment.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: No! What are you doing? The winner... should not be propping up the loser...

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: *cough*... There is no loser here, Blood Knight.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: W-W-We have a winner!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The one left standing at the end–– No, more accurately, the Radiant Knight is holding up the Blood Knight! The Blood Knight... can't stand on his own!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The panel is still tallying up the score, and until now, their scores were neck-and-neck! But, based on what we just saw–– if the Blood Knight is unable to continue fighting, then––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Then, without a doubt––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––The champion of Kazimierz's 24th Special Knight Tournament... is none other than––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ...THE RADIANT KNIGHT! MAAAARGAREEEET NEAAARRRRLLL!!!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ––Execute the plan.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The various teams are moving to strike. The special detachment has entered the arena, targeting Maria Nearl and Whislash Knight.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: While the crowd is in chaos––

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What a deafening roar of applause.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I really do envy the knights' popularity.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: There are some knights who aren't as popular.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It seems like you have some other reason for saying that?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The old knight-lords always remain at the very top. Frustrating, isn't it?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: How curious. I wonder what kind of lives you bounty hunters lead to be able to mingle with the knights?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Ursus artillery destroyed our town. We became a pack of hunters in need of prey to survive.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: One rainy night, we hunted a wild mangler until dawn, only to discover that a 'knight' had long snatched up our prey.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh, that seems like an interesting story.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: He was a decked-out princeling, all glittering and gold, pretending to use the rain to wash off the blood on his face. So we asked, what would a knight be doing all the way out here.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Wanna guess what he said?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: He said, 'I'm not a knight yet, just a wanderer.' Then he asked us, 'Who were you again?'

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Grr.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh my, Monique, when'd you decide to fly in? I thought your part of the operation was quite some distance from here.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: And what's more, you even got hurt.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Cut the crap, Roy. Either call the thing off, or come help me out over here.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Now what kind of wind would be able to blow our own 'wanderer' back here?
Roy the Lazurite is about to get up, but a hand presses down on his shoulder.
A Sarkaz hand.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Heh. 'Wanderer,' huh? At the time, I thought to myself, why the hell are you playing dumb?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: So this is what I said back to him––

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: ––'Standing before you is Kazimierz's strongest bounty hunter.'

steps.name: Cheers
steps.text: Radiant Knight! Radiant Knight! Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A few months ago, what analyst could've predicted this outcome?! That our champion would be the Radiant Knight, Margaret Nearl, after suddenly and shockingly returning to the arena?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Now, let your cheers fill this arena! The prize pool for today's competition has reached an unbelievable amount!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's no exaggeration to say that the Radiant Knight's legendary experience has scored her enough wealth to rival that of an entire corporation!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even the General Chamber of Commerce will be here today to make a huge announcement to everyone!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: To our wonderful friends in the arena and those watching from home! The Knights Association officially confirmed yesterday that they will hold a champion's press conference tomorrow. But right now, there's a truth we must share with all of you!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Six years ago, the Radiant Knight was exiled by the Knights Association for 'concealing her status as an Infected!' But today, the Radiant Knight's name has finally been cleared!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Her exile was the result of a criminal conspiracy! The scoundrels bought off the Knights Association and forcibly expelled the Radiant Knight from the country on false pretenses!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Yes indeed! Here, as a representative of the Knights Association, the National Council, and the General Chamber of Commerce, I solemnly announce to the entire audience––

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––that all accusations against the Radiant Knight are hereby dropped! The Radiant Knight, our great champion, is not an Infected!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait... Doctor, did you purposely...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: 'If you deny your own heart, and conceal the truth from the world, there is no glory to be had.'

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Before Nearl left Rhodes Island, the Doctor told her about the possible consequences.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Even if the K.G.C.C. does not take this as a threat, Nearl... will eventually call upon Rhodes Island to be her notary.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: For the sake of–– Wait, wait...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Why now of all times to come clean? Goddammit, the K.G.C.C. is trying to get the Infected to turn on each other!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: This is bad. They're trying to make it look like the Radiant Knight doesn't represent them, and that their champion lost––

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...To make it seem as if... my sister... lied to everyone.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Wh-What's going on? Is Margaret not Infected?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: In order to protect the young and energetic Margaret, Old Nearl purposely had her exiled.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: She was exiled... because of Grandpa?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Even Margaret herself did not know about this. She truly believed she had contracted Oripathy during the competitions, and even came to terms with it.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: But Oripathy is not something that can be hidden forever. After this many years, she must've discovered the truth long ago.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Margaret...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: (Now's our chance. Go, go!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Ugh! What–?! What just knocked my dagger––?!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You worthless–– I'll handle this!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Armorless?! Maria, watch out!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh?
Zofia stands her ground in front of Maria.
The Armorless assassin raises the dagger in his hand.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Despicable cutthroat.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Gah! You did that with just your hilt?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Damn you––!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Innocent people will get hurt here.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'd prefer you not disturb the peace.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: This one's mine!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Th-Thanks, Shining...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Hey, what's the meaning of this?! The Radiant Knight isn't Infected?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I... What kind of sick joke? I thought this whole time... she was fighting for the Infected! But all along, she...

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: Could it be that the Radiant Knight was lying to us?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You've been made a pawn.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I realized it shortly after leaving Kazimierz.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Oripathy is like a curse, and yet my body... showed no signs of it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The rest fell into place soon after that. My grandfather had me leave Kazimierz, all for the sake of protecting my rash and impetuous self.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The General Chamber of Commerce will not relent until the 'Radiant Knight' is no longer a thorn in their side.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...*cough* *cough*... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Here, lean on my shoulder.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Many thanks.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: If not for the worsening of your condition, I well could've been the one to lose this match.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: There's no point saying things like that... Do you think I fought my way here just to use my Oripathy as an excuse?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The Infected will not trust you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: They are very wise. They did not let you spread your prestige among the masses. They set you up to be the villain.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do you also think of me that way?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Me? Hah......

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: An Infected who fights for the Infected, or a normal person who fights for the Infected... Which is more noble?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Some people do understand this principle, but, public opinion will ignite their extremism... The days you spend here will not be pleasant.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It would seem that this news has already caused quite a stir–– Oh my, the panel has come to its final decision: the Radiant Knight's victory is well-deserved––!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Tonight, Kazimierz will crown a new champion! In two hours, the Radiant Knight, Margaret Nearl, will enter the annals of history at the Wall of Champions!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But don't go anywhere, because tomorrow, we'll have our grand closing ceremony! You won't want to miss it!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Dikaiopolis.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: A knight belongs where there is glory to be had.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Of course. If you really wanted to give them a slap across the face, you could just ditch the award ceremony...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No, that would just be running away. Same as how I ran from Kazimierz back then.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: So... what's your plan?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We'll go together.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Hah... Hahaha... Interesting.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: It'd be my honor.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Next, a few words from the host–– Wait, hold on! Something's happening down there!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Radiant Knight is ignoring the host! She... she's helping the Blood Knight up and heading for the arena's exit!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's the meaning of this?! Does the Radiant Knight plan to share the championship with the Blood Knight?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Damn you... Trying to virtue signal now that your lies are out in the open?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Drop the act already, Radiant Knight! Traitor to the Infected!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––that all accusations against the Radiant Knight are hereby dropped! The Radiant Knight, our great champion, is not an Infected!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Radiant Knight... isn't an Infected?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: J-Justyna, are you alright...?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Yeah, I'm just... shocked.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Did the K.G.C.C. make that up?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It's not difficult to frame a normal person as an Infected, but it is virtually impossible to hide an Infected.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So, the Radiant Knight isn't an Infected...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Then why... Why has she been fighting for us all this time?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Monique! The Radiant Knight and the Blood Knight have left the arena! Do we go after them?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: ...Monique? Hello?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: ––Wh-What's going on? What happened in the arena?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Grr... They weren't kidding when they said three was enough. Practically snapping my arrows like toothpicks...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: D-Did he seriously cleave that pillar with just a swing of his sword? Those pillars have to be made out of cardboard or something, right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Calm down, we're out of our depth here. Let's back up for now and regroup with the main force.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The only weakness of the 'Silverlance Pegasi' is their stubborn adherence to tradition. They won't have any other tricks up their sleeves.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What?! What's going on?! Someone's attacking the Wall!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (The Armorless Union?! They would dare to launch an attack when the audience hasn't even left yet?!)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Everyone, p-please don't panic! Security! Yes, security will make sure you get to safety––!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: ––I thought the knights of the Nearl family were supposed to be all shiny and glowing.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Seriously though, Młynar. Why stick your nose where it doesn't belong? You aren't even a knight, and if you plan to stay in the Grand Knight Territory, you know better than to anger the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Ten years.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I worked for ten years, and not once did I ask for a leave over personal matters.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: In other words... Right now, I am legally entitled to three months of vacation.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Gah... Stop scurrying around, you pesky bounty hunter.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Haha, Młynar Nearl on vacation? That's a perverse joke if I've ever heard one.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ––One more thing, Roy.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Huh?
Light flashes through the Lazurite's vision.
Like the morning breeze wafting through a forest, it is neither strong nor conspicuous. Almost as if the lake's surface could block it.
But in a heartbeat, Młynar's sword is resting against the Lazurite's neck.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Whether or not we're knights... is not for you to decide.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Haha, then who does get to decide?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Kazimierz has no right to dub me.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you still able to walk?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: I'm fine... But more importantly, have you thought about what doing this means?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm just reclaiming the title of 'knight' from them.

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: L-Look, isn't that the Blood Knight and the Radiant Knight?!

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: Are they going to walk to the Wall of Champions like that?! Hey, c'mere and take a picture, quick!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: We can't reach the two Lazurites... The Radiant Knight and Blood Knight are slowly moving towards the Wall of Champions exhibition hall.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Spokesman... The Radiant Knight and the Blood Knight are headed for the Wall of Champions together, and the Board of Directors is very unhappy about this development...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Have the Armorless stop them. Otherwise, they'll be branded as enemies of the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: This is for their own good.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Understood. Oh and a letter for you that came in this morning.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: A letter?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes. According to the Messenger, it was signed 'Your Friend.'

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Just leave it over there. I'll see you later.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Hm? All right then...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}... I'm sorry, but this is all I can do for you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Forgive me. Forgive me for not even daring to read your letter.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Maybe only after you've left the Grand Knight Territory... will I have the right to respond to it.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Has this road... always been this long?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You're wounded, so we're walking slower.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Look! Look over there!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Block the road!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Radiant Knight, Blood Knight, there are countless crossbows pointed at you. All we ask... is that you turn back right now.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Those are the orders we got from the K.G.C.C. We do not wish to have to strike down our two champions.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: It seems... that our pilgrimage ends here.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Go. My head has already been bowed in defeat for a long time. I will let them know––
An arrow lodges into the ground between the two knights and the Armorless.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Justice Knight
steps.text: (Excited clicking noises)

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You're––

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What are you looking at, Armorless scum?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: ––Enemies! The Infected are attacking! Fiiiiire!!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Your bolts won't reach our champion, Armorless.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Try this on for size!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: The Infected are here!! Call for backup––

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: What?! Our comms are cut off?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: A perfect shot.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This would be our second official meeting, right? Our two champions.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If we find the time, I'd love to get autographs from both of you––

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But for now, keep moving forward. Just follow this road down to the end, right through the city.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This is the greatest of causes.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris again? Looks like the campaign knights still haven't shown up.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Wandering into a nice, wide-open space like that is just begging to get sniped––
Don't move.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Let them go, Platinum.

steps.name: A Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Requesting backup! Requesting backup!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Roy, we can't be wasting any more time.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Grrr... Look for a chance to retreat. I'll stop them.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...Be careful.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: What'cha mumbling about over there?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Haha... Well, well... hasn't this turned into a pain in the ass.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: We're in position––

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona, there's no end to these Armorless goons! We'll be in trouble if this drags on!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, come help us out, you bunch of louts!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Tsk... What a bunch of cowards.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Iwona, behind you!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Maria!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm here to help!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: It's Maria Nearl! Get them––!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Keep your hands off her.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Kowal, you ready over there?!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Way ahead of you!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You should've stayed in your nursing home... Surround them!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: What's going on? Why's my weapon shaking?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Heehee... I wonder why?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Radiant Knight's actions are a slap across the face to the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Is this the rest of the Union? What about the two Sarkaz knights?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: W-We haven't seen them... since the last time they tried to assassinate Nightzmora...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Forget it. Get out there and back up our forces. We MUST stop the Radiant Knight and the Blood Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Even if you have to kill them–

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.
She holds up a ball of candlelight.
A beautiful, wispy glow.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Just leave them alone, won't you?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Teams 7 and 8 are in position.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: We've got a lot of witnesses, more every minute, but we have to do it anyway. Get ready to take the shot on the Grand Knights–
(Footsteps).
The onlookers, the knights, the Armorless Union, and the members of Pinus Sylvestris locked in combat, all stop what they were doing.
Like children witnessing the steel leviathan that is a train roar past for the first time.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...That's...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The 'Silverlance Pegasi!'
The Armorless subconsciously stop their attack and lower their weapons.
Their breathing turns solemn, as if a single rash move would result in bloody retribution.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Margaret.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That voice! Uncle Liam?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You've...

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Even now, you intend to stay your path?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Soldiers are a part of the country.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Soldiers carry out duty, not justice.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've already told you this.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Indeed, I cannot lift an Infected through the entire city.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Heed my orders.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Escort the Radiant Knight and the Blood Knight to the Wall of Champions exhibition hall.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: A single road.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: So many people, so many events, all converging alongside you.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: How it reminds me of you, back in the day.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Report the Radiant Knight's current position.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Monique! Thank goodness, we finally got through to you––

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Hurry!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Yes ma'am! They'll reach the Wall in about ten minutes–– a Silverlance Pegasus squad is escorting them. We can't make a move!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'll snipe her. I'll only get one shot at this.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Once my position is exposed... the Silverlance Pegasi can strike clear through a building.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You must draw their attention.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Grand Knight.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Oho, if it isn't little Amiya. Come here. Have you enjoyed your stay in Kazimierz?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We managed to solve a lot of problems, all thanks to the Doctor.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Without Rhodes Island serving as mediators with the General Chamber of Commerce, the situation in Area 0 would not have been resolved peacefully. You have my thanks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's what we do.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: And you must be Dr. {@nickname}? Several companies suddenly started submitting applications regarding Area 0 to the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi, giving us ample 'grounds' to conduct an investigation.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Was this also your work?

options: I think we both did our parts.
I only did what I thought the Adeptus wanted us to do.
It's because we understand each other, right?

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Did Gravel did a good job?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, of course!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She helped us a great deal!

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Then maybe it's time for her to leave the nest and hone her skills elsewhere.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: But that's a discussion for another day. As for these two Sarkaz... You go by Shining and Nightingale, right?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: It's not often that Sarkaz visit these halls... Go meet the Radiant Knight. She needs people she can rely on.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I see it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That golden, glistening exhibition hall.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Haha... In what kind of sport... does the winner and loser share the pedestal?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The folks on the Board of Directors must be livid right now.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: If we...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: —Watch out!
A lazurite bolt tears through the curtain of night.
In a flash, the tip is but hairs away from Margaret's face.
But––
What touches her first is a warm, gentle hand.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Did you need a hand, Nearl?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You... You're...
The breath of life permeates the space.
And the blue of his home, like a soaring fowlbeast, lands on the Sarkaz's shoulder.
Shining turns to face a certain direction, her lips curling up slightly.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...'The Fourth Arrow,' huh?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: That's too bad.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Sarkaz, what relationship do you have... with the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Companions.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Go, Nearl.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Welcome, Margaret, Dikaiopolis.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...The Grand Knight...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: I've never seen this place... without flashing lights and a sea of reporters...

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: They didn't have the guts to push through the campaign knights to conduct their interviews.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Just for tonight... the Wall of Champions belongs only to the knights.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Never has that sounded more ironic.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: This exhibition hall predates the existence of the knight competitions. In the past, this place was a museum that preserved the relics of those heroes...

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: That was a long time ago.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: You still haven't changed your mind, right?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Margaret, you...

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Very well. Just like I couldn't convince your grandfather back then... Come, come closer, and let me have a look at you.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Kirill's granddaughter is all grown up now... It's uncanny how much you take after him. He... would've been proud.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: What you seek to do goes against the flow of the times, Margaret.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: You don't need the privilege of the military, of nobility, or of competitive fame.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: This is only your beginning, young lady. Even after all these twists and turns, you've only just begun your tumultuous journey.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: It's almost dawn.
